hero.title: EMAT Chile v2
hero.subtitle: Reduced Budget Web Migration & Redesign Proposal
hero.description: An adjusted comprehensive digital transformation proposal with reduced budget and part-time work to modernize EmatChile's online presence.

mainContent.quote: Migrating and modernizing EmatChile's website with a new professional landing page design and complete infrastructure optimization at an adjusted budget.

overview.title: Adjusted Digital Transformation
overview.description: This project consists of the complete migration of EmatChile's website from Azure to Namecheap, along with a professional redesign of its landing page and the subsequent creation and implementation of new sections.
overview.focus: The total budget has been adjusted to $9,300,000 COP, with an extended timeline since development will be done part-time, without reducing quality or eliminating parts of the scope.
overview.guarantee: Critical phases (landing design, WordPress update, implementation and migration) will be completed before December 20, ensuring the site is modern, stable and operational before year-end.

objective.title: Modernization & Optimization
objective.description: Modernize and optimize EmatChile's website through a new modular and professional visual design, complete migration to Namecheap with hosting, DNS and SSL configuration, WordPress environment and dependencies update, new custom templates for products, store and complementary sections, performance optimization, basic SEO and mobile compatibility.

scope.title: Complete Adjusted Solution
items: New sections (product listing, individual view and others to be defined)
Validation, testing, optimization and initial support

phase1.title: Landing Page Redesign
phase1.description: Completely new visual design based on industry references (HDT Energy, IBC Solar, Power Warehouse).
includes: Menus, sections, CTAs and main hero
Modern, clean and corporate style UI

phase2.title: WordPress Environment Update
phase2.description: WordPress and main plugins update, staging environment creation and migration preparation.

phase3.title: New Landing Page Implementation
phase3.description: Custom development in a Child Theme, HTML/CSS/JS layout, WordPress integration and responsive adjustments.

phase4.title: Migration to Namecheap & Domain Change
phase4.description: Complete site migration with database + files, domain configuration, DNS, SSL certificates and functional testing.

phase5.title: New Sections Design
phase5.description: Design of product listing, individual view, and additional sections to be defined.

phase6.title: New Sections Implementation
phase6.description: Development of custom templates for WordPress and WooCommerce.

phase7.title: Final Validation & Optimization
phase7.description: Final optimization: performance, basic SEO, responsive design, final corrections.

timeline.title: Nov 18, 2025 → Feb 21, 2026
timeline.description: Extended timeline with part-time development to optimize costs while maintaining complete scope.

budget.title: Adjusted Total Budget
budget.timeDescription: Part-time development timeline maintaining complete scope

finalNotes.title: Project Guarantees
notes: The scope remains complete despite the budget reduction
The timeline is extended because development will be done part-time to optimize costs
The site will be operational and updated before December 27
The rest of improvements will advance progressively in January-February under an organized and professional flow

conclusion.title: Ready to Start Your Optimized Digital Transformation?
conclusion.description: Let's work together with this adjusted proposal to create a modern, efficient and scalable web solution that reflects EmatChile's innovation and leadership in the energy sector.
